description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
